checks.evidence: Seven source-located Figure 10 records have endpoint, qualitative raw value, unit/readout rationale, target species/strain, assay conditions, statistics, and locators.
APD6/CAMP/dbAMP rows are not over-promoted: exact sequence and E. faecalis target conflicts remain explicit while source-supported qualitative activity rows are linked.
No direct mode-of-action claim is made; activity assays and computational structure predictions remain contextual evidence.
Supplementary index, text JSONL, file types, and OA archive were reopened; no local structured supplement table changes worker-2/4/6 outputs.
rwk-complete-test-0001 closed after source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked APD6/CAMP/dbAMP rows describe the same EchAMP mature sequence and activity paper, but exact sequence is not printed in local primary material and CAMP overgeneralizes the E. faecalis target. These remain caution-preserved statuses rather than blockers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The paper has no MIC/MBC/toxicity table. Figure 10 and methods provide valid source-located qualitative/statistical alamarBlue bacteriostatic evidence for six positive bacterial targets and one source-negative target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Growth inhibition and computational alpha-helicity/O-glycosylation context are not direct mode-of-action evidence; the final mechanism record avoids direct mechanism overclaim.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_final_adjudication: The prior blocking ticket is closed because owner-layer gaps were source-reviewed, supported rows were recovered, conflicts were preserved, and no blocking/major QC failure remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figure 10 reports statistical growth-curve inhibition, not MIC/MBC/IC50 endpoint values.
Local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database material does not provide machine-readable RFU point tables; no graph digitization was used.
Primary local material supports EchAMP identity/accession and 90 aa/71 aa lengths, while exact 71 aa database sequence remains database-snapshot evidence.
CAMP broad target list includes Enterococcus faecalis, but primary Figure 10G reports no inhibition for that species.
No local source surface reports hemolysis, mammalian cytotoxicity, or selectivity index for EchAMP.
No direct mode-of-action assay is present; computational and activity context remain bounded.
